log: |rule|Species Clause: Limit one of each Pokémon

decisions.thought: Plan: Rotom leads to scout, Volt Switch and burn physical threats. Gholdengo handles Primarina, Garganacl and Dragonite, can Nasty Plot late. Dragonite saved as Mega Dragon Dance sweeper with Multiscale intact; Extreme Speed helps vs Sneasler. Avoid letting Kingambit set up freely.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing team preview matchups and selecting three Pokémon while weighing type advantages and mega evolution constraints.Finalizing the team as Rotom-Wash, Gholdengo, and Mimikyu after adjusting for type coverage and status immunity.

decisions.thought: Lead Primarina to handle Garchomp, Dragonite, and Kingambit, and use Encore on setup sweepers. Bring Dragonite (Lum Berry + Multiscale) as setup sweeper and check to Rotom-Wash/Garchomp. Bring Kingambit as late-game Supreme Overlord cleaner against Mimikyu and Gholdengo.

Plan: Volt Switch Primarina to scout and pivot to Gholdengo, which resists Fairy and handles Primarina/Garganacl. Save Dragonite Mega with Multiscale intact as late Dragon Dance sweeper; Extreme Speed for Sneasler. Burn Kingambit/Sneasler with Rotom, avoid free Kingambit setup.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing Pokémon 3v3 matchup and Volt Switch pivot decision for Rotom versus Primarina.

decisions.thought: Opposing lead is Rotom-Wash. Primarina has high SpD + Sitrus Berry to tank Volt Switch or Thunderbolt and hit hard with Moonblast. Keep Dragonite's Multiscale and Lum Berry intact for sweeping later rather than risking them on Volt Switch pivot. Kingambit cleans late game.

Primarina at 60% after Volt Switch. Pivot to Gholdengo: resists Fairy, threatens Make It Rain, can Nasty Plot/Recover. Save Dragonite Mega with Multiscale intact as late Dragon Dance sweeper; Extreme Speed for Sneasler. Rotom to burn Kingambit/Sneasler. Unknown 2 opponents remain.

Primarina at 60% after Volt Switch; Moonblast only did ~26% to Gholdengo. Plan: Nasty Plot now while Primarina can't threaten, then +2 Make It Rain/Shadow Ball breaks Primarina, Garganacl, Dragonite. Save Dragonite Mega with Multiscale as late Dragon Dance sweeper; Rotom burns Kingambit/Sneasler. Two opponents still unknown.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Estimating damage ranges for Gholdengo moves against Primarina and evaluating Nasty Plot versus attacking.

decisions.thought: Opponent has Rotom-Wash (Volt Switch) and Gholdengo (Leftovers, bulky/Nasty Plot likely). 3rd unseen. Primarina is at 113 HP with Sitrus Berry intact; it survives Make It Rain/Shadow Ball ( triggers Sitrus) and hits hard with Sparkling Aria (~50%). Keep Dragonite healthy for setup and Kingambit for late game.

Gholdengo outsped Primarina on Turn 2, so attack now. +2 Make It Rain is super-effective and should KO Primarina at 60% before Sparkling Aria KOs Gholdengo. Save Dragonite Mega with Multiscale as late Dragon Dance sweeper; Rotom burns Kingambit/Sneasler. Two opponents unknown.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing damage calculations and speed tiers to determine if Gholdengo can KO Primarina before being KOed.

decisions.thought: Opponent has Rotom-Wash (Volt Switch) and Gholdengo (Leftovers, Nasty Plot, at 39% HP, +2 SpA). 3rd unseen. Good as Gold blocks Encore. Sparkling Aria did 47%, so it KOs Gholdengo here (or forces Recover). Even if +2 Gholdengo KOs Primarina (113 HP), Kingambit revenges with Sucker Punch/Kowtow Cleave or Dragonite sets up.

Opponent: Rotom-Wash (Volt Switch), Gholdengo (Leftovers, Nasty Plot, Make It Rain, 45% HP, +1 SpA), 3rd unseen.
Bring in Dragonite (Multiscale + Lum Berry). Even if Gholdengo is max Speed, Dragonite (132 Spe) likely outspeeds bulky Leftovers Gholdengo or tanks a hit with Multiscale to Dragon Dance or KO with Earthquake. Save Kingambit with Supreme Overlord for late game.

Primarina fainted to +2 Make It Rain; Gholdengo now neutral SpA, 45% vs fresh Dragonite (likely Multiscale). Preserve Gholdengo for Kingambit/Garganacl/Gholdengo. Rotom-Wash walls Dragonite: Levitate vs Earthquake, high Defense, Will-O-Wisp cripples it. Save own Dragonite Mega/Multiscale as late Dragon Dance sweeper, Extreme Speed for Sneasler. One opponent still unknown.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing Pokémon battle damage, type matchups, and move effects to choose Gholdengo's next action.

decisions.thought: Opponent: Gholdengo (Leftovers, Nasty Plot, Make It Rain, 45% HP, +0 SpA), Rotom-Wash (Volt Switch, Levitate), 3rd unseen (Dragonite/Garchomp/Kingambit/Mimikyu). Dragonite uses Dragon Dance: tanks any Gholdengo hit via Multiscale, cures Thunder Wave or Rotom's Will-O-Wisp with Lum Berry, and gets +1 Atk/Spe to sweep or force trades before Kingambit cleans.

Primarina fainted; Gholdengo 45% neutral SpA saved for later. Opponent Dragonite +1 Atk/Spe fresh vs Rotom. Burn it now to cripple sweep; Rotom bulky, Levitate immune to Earthquake. Then Hydro/Volt chip, break Multiscale. Save own Dragonite (Mega unavailable? item held) as late DD sweeper, Extreme Speed for Sneasler. Last foe unknown: Gholdengo/Kingambit/Sneasler/Garganacl.

Opponent: Rotom-Wash (active, Levitate, Volt Switch), Gholdengo (45% HP, Leftovers, Nasty Plot, Make It Rain), 3rd unseen (Dragonite/Garchomp/Kingambit/Mimikyu). Dragonite is at 100% HP (Multiscale + Lum Berry intact, +1 Atk/Spe). Use Dragon Dance again: Lum cures Will-O-Wisp, Multiscale tanks Volt Switch, getting +2/+2 before attacking or letting Kingambit clean up.

Primarina fainted; Gholdengo 45% saved. Opponent Dragonite +2/+2, Multiscale intact, outspeeds Rotom. Burn is essential to stop sweep; Rotom's bulk, Sitrus and Levitate give best chance to survive and retry Will-O-Wisp. If Rotom falls, Gholdengo resists Dragon to chip, then own Dragonite Extreme Speed revenges. Last foe unknown.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating a Pokémon battle damage calculation and move risk for Rotom versus Dragonite.Comparing switch options and damage ranges to avoid a guaranteed KO while preserving Multiscale.

decisions.thought: Opponent: Rotom-Wash (active, Levitate, Volt Switch, Will-O-Wisp), Gholdengo (45% HP, Leftovers, Nasty Plot, Make It Rain), 3rd unseen (Dragonite/Garchomp/Kingambit/Mimikyu). Dragonite is +2 Atk/+2 Spe with Multiscale and Lum Berry intact. Use Outrage to OHKO Rotom-Wash or heavily dent/KO Gholdengo on switch; Lum Berry cures Outrage confusion. Kingambit cleans late.

Primarina fainted; Rotom fell to +2/+2 Outrage, Multiscale still intact. Both switch-ins likely die to continued Outrage, so sacrifice weakened Gholdengo. Preserve full Dragonite: hope Outrage ends/confuses, then Ice Spinner (4x) breaks Multiscale and Extreme Speed can finish. Last foe unknown.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Pokemon battle damage and switch options against a locked Outrage Dragonite while accounting for Multiscale and resistances.Calculating damage ranges for Outrage against Multiscale and resistances to determine KO thresholds.Evaluating sacrifice order and confusion chance to enable an Ice Spinner KO after Multiscale breaks.

Then Dragonite enters, tanks final Outrage via own Multiscale, and Ice Spinner (4x) should KO. Save Extreme Speed for possible Sneasler; last foe unknown.
